OECD regional typology of small (TL3) regions

Source: R/data.R
tl3_typology.Rd

The OECD territorial classification of small (TL3) regions, with their typologies. build_accounts_indicators() joins it to region_3d to give the urban/rural breakdown typology_UR (from the access-to-cities typology), for the classification declared in config_scaleup(tl_classification = ): "TL2024" (the default; NUTS 2024 for EU countries) or "TL2021" (NUTS 2021).

Usage

tl3_typology

Format

A data frame, one row per classification and TL3 region:

classification

"TL2024" or "TL2021".

iso3

3-letter ISO country code.

region_3d

TL3 region code (the NUTS 3 code for EU countries): the key joined to region_3d.

region_name

Region name (English).

tl3c_id

TL2024 only: the aggregated metropolitan region (TL3C) the region belongs to; the OECD advises aggregating to it when several TL3 regions form one metropolitan region.

typology_access_level1

Access to cities, level 1: MR (metropolitan region) or NM (non-metropolitan).

typology_access_cities

Access to cities, level 2: MR_L (metropolitan, functional urban area above 1.5 million inhabitants), MR_M (metropolitan, 250,000 to 1.5 million), NMR_M (near a functional urban area above 250,000), NMR_S (near a functional urban area of 50,000 to 250,000), NMR_R (remote); .. not available. The column the package uses.

typology_rural_urban

The earlier rural/urban typology: 3_PU predominantly urban, 3_IN intermediate, 3_PR predominantly rural.

typology_rural_urban_extended

TL2024 only: the extended rural/urban typology (close to a city or remote), for some countries.

Source

OECD territorial correspondence table TL2024 (version of 20 November 2026), OECD geographical definitions, https://www.oecd.org/en/data/datasets/oecd-geographical-definitions.html (http://oe.cd/geostats). Built by data-raw/prepare-reference-data.R.

Details

Version. Package version 0.2.0.9000 ships the OECD territorial correspondence table TL2024, version of 20 November 2026: its TL2024 regions (2,628 TL3 regions in 49 countries) and its TL2021 regions (2,598 regions in 44 countries). The OECD revises the typologies in this table: the access-to-cities typology of non-metropolitan regions in EU countries and of non-EU countries was still being updated in that version, and Türkiye has no access-to-cities typology in TL2024 (commuting data are not available). Version 0.1.0 shipped the TL2021 table of the earlier routines (the same 2,598 regions and typology). See vignette("input-data") for the versions by package version.

Between TL2021 and TL2024 the TL3 codes changed in Germany, Finland, the United Kingdom, Latvia, the Netherlands, Norway and Portugal, and the access-to-cities typology of about 200 regions changed (most in Germany and Türkiye). check_inputs() reports how many region codes of the data match each classification.

A tl3_typology.dta in the input folder replaces this table in run_scaleup_pipeline() and run_trade_pipeline(); a table without a classification column is used as it is.
